Question: How do I track my order?
Answer: You'll receive a tracking number via email once your order ships. Click the link in that email or visit our "Order Tracking" page and enter your order number to see real-time updates.

Question: My order hasn't shipped yet—what should I do?
Answer: Orders typically process within 1-3 business days. If you haven't received a shipping confirmation after that, reach out to customer support with your order number for an update.

Question: Can I change the shipping address after placing my order?
Answer: Unfortunately, once an order is placed, the shipping address can't be changed unless it hasn't shipped yet. Contact support immediately, and we'll do our best before it leaves the warehouse.

Question: Why is my tracking page showing "Label Created"?
Answer: The label has been generated but the package hasn't been handed off to the carrier yet. It should show movement within 24 hours.

Question: The tracking shows "Delivered" but I didn't receive my package.
Answer: First, check around your mailbox, with neighbors, or any secure drop-off spots. If it's still not there, report it to us—we'll file a claim and arrange a replacement or refund.

Question: Can I get same-day shipping?
Answer: Same-day shipping is available for orders placed before 12 PM local time on select items. Check the product page for eligibility.

Question: How long does standard shipping take?
Answer: Standard shipping usually takes 3-7 business days within the continental U.S. International orders typically arrive in 7-21 business days depending on customs.

Question: Can I track my package in real time like a ride-share?
Answer: Unfortunately, we can't provide live GPS tracking. You'll receive status updates at each major checkpoint: picked up, in transit, out for delivery, and delivered.

Question: What if the carrier says there's an address issue?
Answer: If the carrier flags your address as undeliverable, contact us right away with the correct information so we can coordinate a redelivery or reroute.

Question: Do I need to sign for my package?
Answer: Most standard deliveries don't require a signature unless you selected Signature Confirmation at checkout. Without it, the carrier may leave the package unattended.

Question: Can I change the delivery time slot?
Answer: We don't control specific carrier delivery windows directly. However, some carriers (like UPS or FedEx) let you schedule redeliveries through their apps—check your tracking email for options.

Question: Will my items arrive together in one package?
Answer: If all items are available and can ship from the same warehouse, they'll arrive together. Sometimes large orders ship in multiple packages to expedite delivery.

Question: How do I know if my order was placed successfully?
Answer: You should receive an immediate order confirmation email. If you don't see it within 15 minutes, check your spam folder or contact support with the details of what you tried to purchase.

Question: Can I cancel my order after placing it?
Answer: Orders can be canceled within 30 minutes of placement if they haven't yet entered the shipping process. After that window, a return would be necessary once delivered.

Question: Why does tracking show a delivery attempt when no one came?
Answer: Carriers sometimes scan packages as "attempted" before actual final delivery. It may appear the next day. If it shows multiple failed attempts, contact us immediately.

Question: Is there a way to receive SMS tracking updates?
Answer: Yes—during checkout or in your account settings, you can opt-in for text message notifications to get real-time delivery alerts on your phone.

Question: My package is stuck in transit for several days. Is that normal?
Answer: Occasional delays happen during peak seasons or due to weather. If tracking hasn't updated in more than 5 business days, let us know and we'll investigate with the carrier.

Question: Can I pick up my order at a physical store?
Answer: Store pickup is available only if you selected it at checkout. If not, your order was shipped directly to you and cannot be redirected to a store after processing.

Question: Do international orders include customs fees?
Answer: Customs duties and import taxes are determined by your country and aren't included in our pricing. You'll be responsible for those fees upon delivery—check with local authorities for estimates.

Question: Can I get expedited shipping on a return label?
Answer: Yes, when generating a return label through our portal, you can choose the shipping speed that suits your needs. Faster service may cost more but speeds up your refund timeline.

Question: What is your return policy for clothing items?
Answer: Clothing items can be returned within 30 days of delivery as long as they are unworn, unwashed, and have original tags attached.

Question: Do you offer free returns?
Answer: Returns with prepaid labels are free for defective or incorrect items. For change-of-mind returns, a $7.50 return shipping fee applies, deducted from your refund amount.

Question: How do I start a return?
Answer: Log into your account, go to "Order History," select the item you want to return, and follow the return wizard. You'll get a prepaid label and instructions for dropping it off.

Question: What if my item arrived damaged?
Answer: Take photos of the damage and the packaging, then contact customer support within 7 days. We'll send a replacement immediately or process a full refund once we receive the item back.

Question: Can I exchange an item instead of returning it?
Answer: While we don't offer direct exchanges, you can place a separate order for the desired item and initiate a return for the original one. If both are within the return window, shipping costs are netted out.

Question: How long does it take to process a refund after returning an item?
Answer: Once the returned item is received at our warehouse, refunds are processed within 3-5 business days. It may take an additional 5-10 business days for the amount to appear on your statement depending on your bank.

Question: What if I return something but get charged full price?
Answer: That shouldn't happen—if your return is eligible and meets policy requirements, you'll be refunded the original purchase amount (minus any applicable return fees). Disputing that would require contacting support with your tracking info.

Question: Do sale or clearance items have different return rules?
Answer: Clearance items are eligible for return within 14 days rather than the standard 30-day window. They must still be unused and in original packaging.

Question: Can I return an item without the original box or packaging?
Answer: We prefer items in their original packaging, but it's not always required. As long as the product is undamaged and in resellable condition, the return should go through fine.

Question: What happens if I miss the return window?
Answer: Returns outside the policy window generally can't be processed. In exceptional circumstances (like documented delivery delays), contact us directly to discuss possible options.

Question: Can I return a gift that was sent to me?
Answer: Yes, if someone gave you an item from our store, the return process is simple. The refund will go back as store credit in the original purchaser's name unless they reach out to authorize a different method.

Question: Do you restock returned items?
Answer: Returned items are inspected and graded. Items in perfect condition are resold; slightly imperfect ones may be sold through our outlet or closeout channels.

Question: Why was my refund for less than the original price?
Answer: If you used a promo code, the discount is prorated across all items. The return fee (if applicable) and any used gift card value are also factored into the final amount.

Question: What payment methods can refunds be issued to?
Answer: Refunds go back to your original payment method: credit/debit card, PayPal, or Apple/Google Pay. Gift cards are refunded as store credit only.

Question: Can I get a cash refund if I paid by card?
Answer: We process all refunds back to the original form of payment for fraud prevention. Cash refunds aren't offered unless required by local consumer law.

Question: How do I know my refund has been sent?
Answer: You'll receive an email confirmation once the refund is processed at our warehouse, including the expected timeline to appear on your statement.

Question: What if only part of my order was defective?
Answer: You can return just the defective item rather than the entire order. We'll process a partial refund for that specific item and let you keep the rest.

Question: Can I use a gift card to pay for a return shipping fee?
Answer: Yes, return shipping fees can be paid with any accepted payment method including gift cards if you need to cover a change-of-mind return cost.

Question: Do electronics have different return policies?
Answer: Electronics are subject to a 14-day return window due to hygiene and warranty reasons. Items must be fully functional with all original accessories, manuals, and packaging included.

Question: What is your policy on personalized or custom items?
Answer: Personalized items (engraved, printed names, custom sizes) are final sale and can't be returned unless the defect was caused by our error in fulfilling the order.

Question: Can I return a subscription item?
Answer: Subscription products like consumables can be canceled anytime before the next shipment. Once delivered, they follow the standard return policy just like any regular purchase.

Question: Why am I getting an "item not eligible" error when trying to return?
Answer: This usually means the item is outside the return window, was marked as final sale, or the condition of the item (e.g., worn clothing, opened media) doesn't meet our return criteria.

Question: Do you accept returns through UPS, FedEx, and USPS?
Answer: Yes, your prepaid return label is compatible with all three carriers (or whichever carrier is indicated on the label). Drop it off at any authorized drop-off location.

Question: What if my refund hasn't shown up after 10 business days?
Answer: Delays can happen with banks or payment processors. If 10 business days have passed since your refund was confirmed, contact us with your receipt—we'll work with our finance team to resolve it.

Question: Can I get an expedited replacement instead of a refund for a damaged item?
Answer: Absolutely—if you'd prefer a replacement over a refund, let support know within the return process and we'll ship a new one right away without waiting for the original item back.

Question: How do I report a billing discrepancy on my order?
Answer: Email billing@ecommerce.com with your order number, screenshot of the charge, and what you believe is correct. The billing team responds within 1-2 business days with a resolution.

Question: Are taxes refunded when I return an item?
Answer: Yes, you'll receive back the full amount paid, including the sales tax collected on that item.

Question: Can someone else return my order for me?
Answer: Returns must be initiated by the original account holder for security reasons. However, a friend or family member can physically drop off the package at the carrier location using your printed label.

Question: What warranty comes with purchases?
Answer: All products come with a standard 1-year limited warranty covering manufacturing defects. Warranty claims are separate from returns and require proof of purchase.

Question: How do I contact customer support for tracking or refund issues?
Answer: You can reach us through the live chat on our website (available 9 AM-9 PM ET, Mon-Sun), by email at help@ecommerce.com with your order number in the subject line, or by phone at 1-800-000-0001.
